title: Room Six Came With a Man in the CLOSET 🛎️
description:
At this motel, whatever the last guest's review card says is what you get. The pool is a bucket.

My dad and I got Room Six. Our card said the man in the closet is very polite.

It's made up. A blocky story, built with code and Blender.
pin: Who wrote the last card about us, the closet man or the motel?
